 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Expand a centered marker into diagonal 2-rays and a 1-lattice."""
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = next(c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 2)
    out = [[0 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]

    # The original 2 grows symmetrically by one cell on each side per row.
    for r in range(n):
        for c in (center - r, center + r):
            if 0 <= c < n:
                out[r][c] = 2

    # The lower diagonal lattice is spaced every four columns. Its two
    # diagonal boundaries are anchored relative to the original marker.
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if ((c - r - center) % 4 == 0
                    and c - r <= center - 4
                    and c + r >= center + 2
                    and out[r][c] == 0):
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
